en.headline: HKUST 35th anniversary Impact Fiesta opens at Central harbourfront today
en.dek: The free two-day event at AIA Vitality Park features space robots, AI cinema, mixed-reality art and a 1991-drone light show on Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology is hosting its 35th Anniversary Impact Fiesta at AIA Vitality Park on the Central harbourfront today and tomorrow.

Admission is free. On Friday the event runs from noon to 7pm; on Saturday it runs from 11am to 7pm. The university said the programme brings research from its Clear Water Bay campus into the city centre through interactive exhibitions, STEM workshops and public lectures.

Visitors can see full-scale models of the Hong Kong Operation Robot designed for a national lunar mission and MUSICO, a carbon-monitoring payload currently on the Tiangong space station. Other zones cover AI and robotics, start-ups, and the returning SURREALITY mixed-reality art exhibition.

On Saturday evening a light show using 1,991 drones will take place over Victoria Harbour from about 6.20pm to 6.30pm. The university said all proceeds from the event will go to the Children’s Cancer Foundation.

zh.headline: 科大35周年Impact Fiesta今日中環海濱開幕
zh.dek: 免費兩日活動於AIA Vitality Park舉行，展出太空機械人、AI電影、混合實境藝術，周六有1991架無人機燈光秀。
body: 香港科技大學今日及明日於中環海濱AIA Vitality Park舉行35周年Impact Fiesta。
入場免費。周五由中午12時至晚上7時，周六由上午11時至晚上7時。大學表示，活動把清水灣校園的研究成果帶到市中心，透過互動展覽、STEM工作坊及公開講座讓市民近距離體驗。
市民可看到為國家探月任務研發的香港操作機械人1:1模型，以及目前在天宮空間站運行的碳監測載荷MUSICO。其他展區涵蓋人工智能與機械人、初創企業，以及再度登場的SURREALITY混合實境藝術展。
周六傍晚約6時20分至6時30分，將有1991架無人機在維港上空進行燈光秀。大學指活動所有收益將捐予兒童癌病基金。
